rule: Each question was manually reviewed against its exact Notes.html anchor; this file stages replacements only.

fixes.explanation_en: Core Taiga agriculture is restricted by long cold winters, a short frost-free season, cold acidic or weakly developed soils, waterlogging and locally permafrost. Farming is more feasible along southern margins, river valleys and managed sites.
fixes.explanation_te: Core Taigaలో పొడవైన చల్లని శీతాకాలం, చిన్న మంచురహిత కాలం (Frost-free Season), చల్లని ఆమ్ల లేదా బలహీన నేలలు, Waterlogging, కొన్ని చోట్ల Permafrost వ్యవసాయాన్ని పరిమితం చేస్తాయి. Southern Margins, River Valleys, నిర్వహించిన ప్రదేశాల్లో సాగు కొంత అనుకూలం.
option_explanations_en: Correct: all listed factors restrict crop growth and soil use.
Year-round heat and extreme evapotranspiration describe hot dry regions, not Taiga.
Ocean salinity is not the main inland Taiga constraint.
Taiga has strong seasonal light variation, not total annual darkness.
option_explanations_te: సరైనది. ఇచ్చిన Factors అన్నీ Crop Growth, Soil Useను పరిమితం చేస్తాయి.
Year-round Heat, Extreme Evapotranspiration Hot Dry Regions లక్షణాలు; Taigaవి కాదు.
Ocean Salinity ప్రధాన Inland Taiga Constraint కాదు.
Taigaలో Seasonal Light Variation ఉంటుంది; ఏడాది మొత్తం Darkness కాదు.

reviews.evidence: p100-agriculture anchor lists all limiting factors; key 1 retained.

fixes.explanation_en: Cold-tolerant, short-season crops such as barley, oats, rye and potatoes may grow in suitable Taiga margins. Cabbage and fodder crops are also possible where soils, drainage and the growing season permit.
fixes.explanation_te: అనుకూల Taiga Marginsలో చలిని తట్టుకునే, చిన్న Growing Season పంటలైన Barley, Oats, Rye, Potato పండవచ్చు. Soil, Drainage, Season అనుకూలిస్తే Cabbage, Fodder Crops కూడా సాగు చేయవచ్చు.
option_explanations_en: Rice, rubber and cocoa generally require warmer or wetter conditions.
Correct: these are cold-tolerant short-season crops.
Coffee, tea and banana are not the standard Taiga-margin combination.
Date palm and cotton favour warmer climates.
option_explanations_te: Rice, Rubber, Cocoa సాధారణంగా ఎక్కువ Warm లేదా Wet Conditions కోరుతాయి.
సరైనది. ఇవి Cold-tolerant Short-season Crops.
Coffee, Tea, Banana ప్రామాణిక Taiga-margin Combination కాదు.
Date Palm, Cotton వెచ్చని Climatesకు అనుకూలం.

reviews.evidence: p100-agriculture anchor explicitly lists these crops; key 2 retained.

fixes.explanation_en: Forest area measures land extent; growing stock measures standing timber volume; annual harvest measures wood removed; industrial roundwood output records a production flow. Rankings can differ because these are not interchangeable metrics.
fixes.explanation_te: Forest Area భూవిస్తీర్ణాన్ని; Growing Stock నిలిచిన కలప పరిమాణాన్ని; Annual Harvest తొలగించిన కలపను; Industrial Roundwood Output ఉత్పత్తి ప్రవాహాన్ని కొలుస్తాయి. ఇవి ఒకే Metric కాదు కాబట్టి Rankings మారవచ్చు.
option_explanations_en: Latitude and longitude are coordinates, not the forest-statistics metrics at issue.
Rain and snowfall are precipitation forms, not timber metrics.
Correct: all four measure different forest-resource quantities.
Country and capital are political labels, not statistical measures.
option_explanations_te: Latitude, Longitude Coordinates; అడిగిన Forest Metrics కాదు.
Rain, Snowfall Precipitation Forms; Timber Metrics కాదు.
సరైనది. నాలుగూ వేర్వేరు Forest-resource Quantitiesను కొలుస్తాయి.
Country, Capital Political Labels; Statistical Measures కాదు.

reviews.evidence: p100-forest-resource anchor explicitly distinguishes all four metrics; key 3 retained.

fixes.explanation_en: Boreal conifer timber enters two major processing paths: sawnwood and panels for construction, or fibre pulp for paper, paperboard and packaging. This sequence is the softwood value chain.
fixes.explanation_te: Boreal Conifer Timber రెండు ప్రధాన Processing Pathsలోకి వెళ్తుంది: Construction కోసం Sawnwood, Panels; లేదా Paper, Paperboard, Packaging కోసం Fibre Pulp. ఇదే Softwood Value Chain.
option_explanations_en: Ore–smelter–steel is a mineral-metallurgy chain.
Sheep–wool–cloth is an animal-fibre chain.
Grape–wine–port is an agricultural beverage chain.
Correct: this follows conifer timber through wood and fibre products.
option_explanations_te: Ore–Smelter–Steel Mineral-metallurgy Chain.
Sheep–Wool–Cloth Animal-fibre Chain.
Grape–Wine–Port Agricultural Beverage Chain.
సరైనది. ఇది Conifer Timber నుంచి Wood, Fibre Products వరకు క్రమం.

reviews.evidence: p100-lumbering anchor lists softwood inputs and products; key 4 retained.

fixes.explanation_en: Siberia’s large forest area does not guarantee easy extraction. Long distances, permafrost, limited infrastructure, wildfire risk and market access raise costs and constrain actual use.
fixes.explanation_te: Siberiaలో Forest Area విస్తారంగా ఉన్నా Extraction సులభం కాదు. Long Distance, Permafrost, పరిమిత Infrastructure, Wildfire Risk, Market Access సమస్యలు ఖర్చును పెంచి వినియోగాన్ని పరిమితం చేస్తాయి.
option_explanations_en: Correct: these physical and economic constraints jointly limit extraction.
Equatorial humidity does not characterise Siberia.
Coral reefs are unrelated to inland boreal logging.
Siberia has extensive forests; tree absence is not the problem.
option_explanations_te: సరైనది. Physical, Economic Constraints కలిసి Extractionను పరిమితం చేస్తాయి.
Equatorial Humidity Siberia లక్షణం కాదు.
Coral Reefsకు Inland Boreal Loggingతో సంబంధం లేదు.
Siberiaలో Extensive Forests ఉన్నాయి; Tree Absence సమస్య కాదు.

reviews.evidence: p100-lumbering anchor directly lists these constraints; key 1 retained.

fixes.explanation_en: Pulp is a mass of separated wood fibres produced mechanically or chemically. It is the intermediate material used to manufacture paper, paperboard, newsprint and related products.
fixes.explanation_te: Mechanical లేదా Chemical Processతో విడదీసిన కలప నారల సమూహాన్ని గుజ్జు (Pulp) అంటారు. ఇది Paper, Paperboard, Newsprint వంటి ఉత్పత్తులకు Intermediate Material.
option_explanations_en: Iron ore is a mineral raw material, not pulp.
Correct: separated wood fibres define pulp.
Petroleum residue is unrelated to wood-fibre pulp.
Unprocessed wool is animal fibre, not wood pulp.
option_explanations_te: Iron Ore Mineral Raw Material; Pulp కాదు.
సరైనది. Separated Wood Fibresనే Pulp.
Petroleum Residueకు Wood-fibre Pulpతో సంబంధం లేదు.
Unprocessed Wool Animal Fibre; Wood Pulp కాదు.

reviews.evidence: p100-pulp-paper anchor gives exact process and products; key 2 retained.

fixes.explanation_en: A national superlative requires a stated year, exact product, metric—production or export—unit and authoritative source. Without them, an old Canada newsprint ranking cannot be scored as a timeless current fact.
fixes.explanation_te: Country Superlativeను Score చేయాలంటే Year, Exact Product, Production లేదా Export Metric, Unit, Authoritative Source అవసరం. ఇవి లేకుండా Canada Newsprint Rankingను కాలాతీత Current Factగా వాడరాదు.
option_explanations_en: A nickname provides no measurable evidence.
A forest map does not establish industrial output rank.
Correct: all five evidence fields are necessary for a defensible ranking.
Climate type alone cannot prove a production ranking.
option_explanations_te: Nickname కొలవదగిన Evidence ఇవ్వదు.
Forest Map Industrial Output Rankను నిర్ధారించదు.
సరైనది. Defensible Rankingకు ఐదు Evidence Fields అవసరం.
Climate Type ఒక్కటే Production Rankingను నిరూపించదు.

reviews.evidence: p100-pulp-paper anchor explicitly requires these evidence fields; key 3 retained.

fixes.explanation_en: Mineral deposits reflect geological history and ore-forming processes such as magmatism, hydrothermal activity, sedimentation and metamorphism. Taiga climate affects access, cost and environmental risk, not the original creation of every ore.
fixes.explanation_te: Mineral Depositsను Geological History, Magmatism, Hydrothermal Activity, Sedimentation, Metamorphism వంటి Ore-forming Processes ఏర్పరుస్తాయి. Taiga Climate Extraction Access, Cost, Environmental Riskను ప్రభావితం చేస్తుంది; ప్రతి Oreను సృష్టించదు.
option_explanations_en: Cold climate can affect extraction but does not create every ore.
Conifer roots do not create nickel deposits.
Snowfall does not form petroleum deposits.
Correct: geological history and mineralisation control deposit formation.
option_explanations_te: Cold Climate Extractionను ప్రభావితం చేయవచ్చు; ప్రతి Oreను సృష్టించదు.
Conifer Roots Nickel Depositsను సృష్టించవు.
Snowfall Petroleum Depositsను ఏర్పరచదు.
సరైనది. Geological History, Mineralisation Deposit Formationను నిర్ణయిస్తాయి.

reviews.evidence: p100-minerals anchor directly separates geological origin from climate effects; key 4 retained.

fixes.explanation_en: Kiruna–Malmberget in northern Sweden is a major high-grade iron-ore district. Railways connect the mines to Narvik and Luleå for export and processing transport.
fixes.explanation_te: Northern Swedenలోని Kiruna–Malmberget ప్రధాన High-grade Iron-ore District. Railways గనులను Export, Processing Transport కోసం Narvik, Luleå Portsతో కలుపుతాయి.
option_explanations_en: Correct: the district is internationally noted for iron ore.
Bauxite is not its defining resource.
Petroleum is not the resource associated with this mining district.
Nitrates are not the noted Kiruna–Malmberget resource.
option_explanations_te: సరైనది. ఈ District Iron Oreకు ప్రసిద్ధి.
Bauxite దీని Defining Resource కాదు.
Petroleum ఈ Mining Districtతో సంబంధిత ప్రధాన వనరు కాదు.
Nitrates Kiruna–Malmberget ప్రసిద్ధ వనరు కాదు.

reviews.evidence: p100-regions anchor identifies the Swedish iron-ore district; key 1 retained.

fixes.explanation_en: Iron ore from northern Sweden moves by rail to Narvik on Norway’s ice-free Atlantic coast and to Luleå on the Baltic coast. Seasonal ice conditions make the two outlets strategically different.
fixes.explanation_te: Northern Sweden Iron Oreను Rail ద్వారా Norwayలోని Ice-free Atlantic Port Narvikకు, Baltic Coastలోని Luleåకు తరలిస్తారు. Seasonal Ice Conditions వల్ల రెండు Outlets వ్యూహాత్మకంగా వేర్వేరు.
option_explanations_en: Jaffa and Seville are not the Swedish iron-ore export pair.
Correct: Narvik and Luleå are the associated ports.
Monaco and Grasse are unrelated to this ore corridor.
Signal Hill and Hollywood are not Swedish mineral ports.
option_explanations_te: Jaffa, Seville Swedish Iron-ore Export Pair కాదు.
సరైనది. Narvik, Luleå సంబంధిత Ports.
Monaco, Grasseకు ఈ Ore Corridorతో సంబంధం లేదు.
Signal Hill, Hollywood Swedish Mineral Ports కాదు.

reviews.evidence: p100-regions anchor explicitly names both ports; key 2 retained.

fixes.explanation_en: Canada’s major resource associations include Quebec–Labrador iron ore, Sudbury nickel–copper and Saskatchewan uranium. They reflect different geological provinces rather than uniform geology across Canada.
fixes.explanation_te: Canadaలో Quebec–Labrador–Iron Ore, Sudbury–Nickel–Copper, Saskatchewan–Uranium ముఖ్య Resource Associations. ఇవి Canada అంతటా ఒకే Geology కాకుండా వేర్వేరు Geological Provincesను సూచిస్తాయి.
option_explanations_en: Cocoa and olives are agricultural products and are incorrectly matched.
Sudbury is not a nitrate district and Yukon is not a tea region.
Correct: all three Canadian resource-region pairs are accurate.
Canadian provinces have varied geological histories and resources.
option_explanations_te: Cocoa, Olives Agricultural Products; జతలు తప్పు.
Sudbury Nitrate District కాదు; Yukon Tea Region కాదు.
సరైనది. మూడు Canadian Resource-region Pairs కచ్చితమైనవి.
Canadian Provincesకు వేర్వేరు Geological Histories, Resources ఉన్నాయి.

reviews.evidence: p100-regions anchor provides all three pairs; key 3 retained.

fixes.explanation_en: Forests are biologically renewable, but regeneration takes decades and depends on management. Mineral deposits are geological non-renewable stocks on human timescales, while agriculture is recurring biological production constrained by climate, soil and water.
fixes.explanation_te: Forests జీవపరంగా Renewable అయినా Regenerationకు దశాబ్దాలు పడవచ్చు; Management అవసరం. Mineral Deposits మానవ కాలప్రమాణంలో Geological Non-renewable Stocks. Agriculture పునరావృత Biological Production అయినా Climate, Soil, Waterపై ఆధారపడుతుంది.
option_explanations_en: The three resources form and renew through different processes.
Minerals do not regenerate annually like crops.
Forest regeneration is slow, not instantaneous.
Correct: this distinguishes biological renewal, geological stocks and agricultural production.
option_explanations_te: మూడు Resources వేర్వేరు Processesతో ఏర్పడి పునరుత్పత్తి అవుతాయి.
Minerals Cropsలా ఏటా Regenerate కావు.
Forest Regeneration నెమ్మదిగా జరుగుతుంది; Instantaneous కాదు.
సరైనది. Biological Renewal, Geological Stocks, Agricultural Productionను వేరు చేస్తుంది.

reviews.evidence: p100-sustainability anchor explicitly makes the three-way comparison; key 4 retained.

main_findings: All twelve answer keys are supported by exact Notes.html anchors.
Generic explanation templates require replacement in every item.
Forest statistics retain metric, year, unit and source distinctions.
Mineral origin is separated from climate-related extraction constraints.
Resource-region, port and sustainability questions now teach the complete causal or value-chain relationship.
